tpld.fz-bulut: A hot-air balloon floating among the clouds, with the baby’s initial on it.
tpld.fz-kubik: The baby’s name drops in on toy blocks. Tap a block to spin it.
tpld.fz-maktub: VIP. A sealed envelope, the baby’s photo in an arch, birth stats, a timeline of the waiting days and wishes.
tpld.fz-oy: A night-time crib mobile: the hanging stars sway and chime when tapped.
tpld.fz-oyoqcha: A minimal birth card: tiny footprints taking steps, the name and birth stats.
tpld.fz-quti: Tap the box 3 times: it opens and blue or pink balloons fly up into the sky, for a boy or a girl.
tpld.sv-atirgul: A rose that blooms before your eyes and falling petals. Velvet background.
tpld.sv-hikoya: The number of days together in big digits, a heart-shaped photo and the story of your relationship.
tpld.sv-konvert: A letter writes itself on paper. With a postage stamp and a dated postmark.
tpld.sv-maktub: VIP. A sealed envelope, both your names above an arch, the day you met on a calendar, a story timeline and reasons.
tpld.sv-yulduz: A heart-shaped constellation in the night sky. Each star holds one warm word.
tpld.sv-yurak: Press and hold the heart: it fills up, beats faster and bursts into hundreds of little hearts to reveal your confession.
tpld.tk-maktub: VIP. A sealed envelope, a photo in an arch, a life-journey timeline, wishes and a secret message. Colors for women and men.
tpld.tk-oltin: An Art Deco frame, gold lettering and a monogram. The age is spelled out in words.
tpld.tk-polaroid: Kraft paper, Polaroid photos and hand-drawn decorations. Tap to flip through the photos.
tpld.tk-salyut: Fireworks burst in the night sky, and the sparks gather to write the name. Every tap sets off new fireworks.
tpld.tk-sharlar: A bunch of balloons: pop each one and a wish comes out.
tpld.tk-tort: Candles shaped like the age: tap to blow them out, make a wish, and confetti bursts.
tpld.toy-gullar: Watercolor flowers, soft colors and an invitation inside an envelope.
tpld.toy-klassik: A frame with gold ornaments, the couple’s names in script, opened with a wax seal.
tpld.toy-maktub: VIP. An envelope with a gold seal, a photo in an arch, a calendar, a schedule with a sliding heart, a dress code and a survey.
tpld.toy-milliy: Girih patterns, a pishtaq-shaped invitation and an arabesque medallion. With VIP, carved doors swing open.
tpld.toy-minimal: Big numbers, thin lines and magazine-style lettering. No extra decoration.
tpld.toy-parda: A silk curtain parts to both sides, gold rings are drawn behind it and your names appear.
tpld.uz-ayiqcha: A teary-eyed teddy bear says sorry. Once forgiven, it smiles and holds up a little heart.
tpld.uz-kechir: Yes and No buttons: No runs away, Yes grows bigger. Once you’re forgiven, the little face smiles.
tpld.uz-maktub: VIP. A sealed envelope, a heartfelt letter, a timeline of promises and an elegant “Will you forgive me?” question. For women and men.
tpld.uz-muz: Melt the ice with your finger, the heart warms up and the question “Will you forgive me?” appears. The answer comes back to you.
tpld.uz-yomgir: Rain falls on the page. Once you’re forgiven, the rain stops and the sun and a rainbow come out.
tpld.uz-yurak: Tap the pieces to put the heart back together, one promise in each piece. The cracks are mended with gold.
